name: Gurungan
description: Fully aquatic sophonts with DEX+2. Gurungan are capable of joining all careers but their aquatic nature creates significant challenges when operating on land for extended periods.

traits.name: Aquatic
traits.description: Gurungan are fully aquatic and can breathe underwater naturally. When out of water, they are reduced to a speed of two metres and must pass an END check every minute or suffer 1D damage. This END test begins at Easy (4+) but increases one difficulty step every minute. Being fully moisturised will stop the difficulty increasing but will not reset back to Easy (4+) until the Gurungan has been fully immersed in water for at least five minutes.

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: All Gurungan have sharp teeth that make for an effective close combat weapon. This bite uses the Melee (natural) skill and does 1D damage.

traits.name: Deep Diver (1,000m)
traits.description: Gurungan can dive deep underwater to a depth of 1,000 metres without risk.

traits.name: Sonar (120m)
traits.description: Gurungan use a highly sensitive sonar sense to navigate their environment, effectively allowing them to 'see' underwater or in complete darkness to a range of 120 metres.

traits.name: Swimmer (8m)
traits.description: Gurungan are good swimmers and can move through water at a speed of eight metres.

source: Traveller Aliens of Charted Space Volume 1, Mongoose Publishing
